title: BPSC Auditor Pre Answer Key 2026
postName: Auditor Preliminary Examination – Advt. related 09/2026 cycle
vacancyDetails: Provisional answer key for BPSC Auditor Prelims written examination
qualification: Graduation / commerce related eligibility as per BPSC Auditor notification
documentsRequired: Admit card, registration credentials, photo ID
howToApply:
1. Visit https://bpsc.bihar.gov.in
2. Open Provisional Answer Key for Auditor Pre Exam
3. Download set-wise PDF
4. Match series and calculate score
5. Submit online representation if allowed by deadline
shortDescription: BPSC Auditor Pre Answer Key 2026 out on 13 July for prelims held on 5 July 2026. Download PDF from bpsc.bihar.gov.in.
content:
Bihar Public Service Commission has released the provisional answer key for the Auditor Preliminary Examination 2026 on about 13 July 2026.

Prelims exam date: 5 July 2026. Candidates can download the series-wise key from bpsc.bihar.gov.in and raise objections online within the commission’s timeline before the final key.
